summary: Master the art of economic forecasting with our specialized course. Gain insights into inflation trends and growth strategies to boost your analytical skills.
lede: Inflation and economic growth forecasting helps professionals make planning, budgeting, risk, and performance decisions using forward-looking economic estimates. Participants learn to assess economic data, build simple time-series and driver-based forecasts, evaluate uncertainty, and communicate assumptions through best-, likely-, and worst-case scenarios.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who require inflation or growth forecasts for planning, budgeting, risk management, and performance decisions.
audience: Government economists, planners, and policy analysts
Central bank, ministry, or regulator staff
modules: Understanding Inflation and Growth Drivers Without the Jargon
Data Readiness for Inflation and Growth Forecasting
Forecasting Economic Growth With Applied Techniques
Building Simple Predictive Models for Drivers
Evaluating Forecast Reliability and Communicating Confidence
prerequisites: Basic understanding of economic principles and familiarity with data analysis tools are recommended. A background in finance, economics, or business administration is helpful but not required.
